about: Worker F2 single-launch exposure + local-tonemap shadow-fusion screening sweep at con_custodial (Nov 17): holds one camera pose (y0_p0) in one launch so cross-launch spawn drift cannot contaminate comparisons, changing [RemixConfig] live across 7 steps of 12 s each with liveStepDump=true (gate/live_step1_final.pfm .. live_step7_final.pfm). Every step writes all 7 rtx.* keys explicitly so SetConfigVariable persistence cannot leak across steps. Multi-variant screening narrows the cause only: steps (2) ae_off_fixed (Stage 1 autoExposure off, Stage 2 shadows=2.0 kept) and (3) shadows_0_only (Stage 1 autoExposure kept, Stage 2 4x Mertens shadow branch off: shadows=0.0) isolate the two causes, while steps (4) evmin_0_shad0, (5) evmin_m1_exp0p35_shad0, and (6) global_tm_evmin_0 screen candidate fixes between (1) base and (7) base_end. Any candidate that passes here requires its own dedicated 3-step base -> variant -> base_end (off / on / off) launch before it counts as a fix. Score with: python -I tests\analysis\brightness\exposure_vs_lights.py --score-live <run_dir> --reference experiments\remix-gate\reference-20261117-133918.
